verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a USB/NFC hardware security key for passkeys/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV and OpenPGP, with no conversational interface. A built-in AI assistant to delegate tasks to is a category error for this kind of product. The Shopify-generated shopping-agent llms.txt on the store site is a host-platform artifact, not a product assistant, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
